name: Klaviyo
shortInfo: Powerful email and SMS marketing automation
brief: Klaviyo is an email marketing platform created for online businesses — featuring powerful email and SMS marketing automation. DataChannel’s Klaviyo Connector lets you sync data from the Klaviyo API automatically into your data warehouse. To understand how users are interacting with your brand, use this connector and track various performance metrics, to target and personalise better.
about:
Klaviyo, is an ecommerce marketing automation platform for email and sms. With a built-in CDP, businesses can integrate more marketing data for higher ROI.  
  
Learn more about [Klaviyo API documentation.](https://www.klaviyo.com/)
availableData:
[All Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/pipelines/all-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of all the metrics in your account.

[Campaign Recipients](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/pipelines/campaign-recipients.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve summary information about email recipients for the campaign.

[Campaigns](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/pipelines/campaigns.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve list of all the campaigns you’ve created.

[Events Data](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/pipelines/events-data.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve event data from Klaviyo, optionally filtering and segmenting on available event properties.

[Events Data - Flows](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/pipelines/events-data-flow.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve event data from Klaviyo grouped by $attributed\_flow.

[Events For All Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/pipelines/events-for-all-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve event data from Klaviyo.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/klaviyo/index.html) here.
